name: Marriott Bonvoy Brilliant® American Express® Card

loungeAccess.network: Priority Pass Select (1,300+ airport lounges worldwide)
loungeAccess.notes: Complimentary Priority Pass Select membership with enrollment required. Includes up to 2 guest passes per visit. Does not include Amex Centurion Lounge access.

tripDelay.notes: Up to $500 per covered trip for delays of 6+ hours. Maximum 2 claims per 12-month period.

tripCancellation.notes: Maximum $10,000 per covered trip, up to $20,000 per eligible card account per 12 consecutive months.

lostBaggage.notes: Covers lost, damaged, or stolen baggage when you pay with this card. High-risk items (jewelry, electronics) capped at $1,000 per person per trip.

emergencyMedical.notes: Premium Global Assist Hotline: 24/7 emergency assistance coordination including medical evacuation transport (Amex covers transport costs), repatriation of mortal remains, and care for unattended children. Does not cover medical treatment costs.

rentalCarInsurance.countries: Worldwide except Australia, Italy, New Zealand, and OFAC-sanctioned countries.
rentalCarInsurance.notes: Secondary coverage — file with personal auto insurance first. Up to 30 consecutive days. Must decline the rental company's CDW.

hotelCredit.notes: Up to $300 in statement credits per calendar year for eligible purchases at restaurants worldwide. (Changed from hotel credit; now a dining credit as of 2022 card refresh.)

otherCredits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Hotel Credit
otherCredits.notes: Up to $100 property credit per stay when booking a Marriott Bonvoy hotel stay of 2+ nights through amextravel.com or by calling Amex Travel.

otherCredits.name: Free Night Award
otherCredits.notes: One annual Free Night Award (up to 85,000 points) each year after card renewal. Redeemable at Marriott Bonvoy properties with redemption levels at or under 85,000 points.

rewards.travelRate: 6x on purchases at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy

pointValue.transferPartners: 0.7–1.2¢ per Marriott Bonvoy point; best redeemed for premium hotel stays

travelPerks: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite status each calendar year
Annual Free Night Award up to 85,000 points after card renewal
Priority Pass Select airport lounge membership (1,300+ lounges)
Up to $300 per year in dining statement credits
Up to $100 property credit per 2-night Marriott stay booked through Amex Travel
Trip delay coverage after 6 hours ($500/trip, 2 claims/year)
Premium Global Assist — emergency evacuation coordination
$100 Global Entry/TSA PreCheck credit every 4 years
Secondary rental car insurance up to $75,000
bestFor: Serious Marriott loyalists who can leverage Platinum Elite status, the 85K free night award, and the dining credit to justify the $650 annual fee
